feeds.title: Sweet Red Poppy
feeds.description: Sewing tutorials for the modern seamstress! It's a place where I can share my never-ending sewing projects and my love of learning. I'm a fabric addict. (The first step is admitting the problem, right?) I'm a lover of colors, textures, and patterns. I also believe the right outfit can change your perspective on life.

feeds.title: Heather Handmade Blog
feeds.description: Covers articles about sewing patterns and beginner sewing projects, fashion design, seamstress, life, pictures, creativity, decorating, clothing and more.

feeds.title: Steely Seamstress
feeds.description: I learned to sew at an early age and I could frequently be found sewing or doing any number of craft activities when I was growing up. My Mum was always sewing clothes and somehow, unconsciously, I just absorbed this knowledge from her. I'll be posting a couple of times a week sharing my thoughts, successes and hiccups. Hope you'll join me for the journey…

feeds.title: Christine Haynes Blog
feeds.description: Christine Haynes is a Brooklyn-based sewing author, teacher, and pattern designer. She is vintage inspired sewing for the modern seamstress. Christine turned her focus to teaching others to experience the joy of making clothing for themselves through her patterns, books, and workshops.

feeds.title: Tracy's Sewing Studio Blog
feeds.description: Passionate about sewing services! Custom garments, costumes, tailoring, fit specialist, sewing blogger, group classes, quality work and timely turnarounds. Our mission is to make my customers happy, do quality work and in a timely fashion. We provide sewing lessons, group parties, and craft nights. We also create custom dresses and offer alterations and limited custom orders.

feeds.title: Vintage on Tap
feeds.description: Vintage on Tap is focused on the technical side of sewing, the advancement of traditional garment construction methods, and development of textile and fiber arts. Focusing on slowing down and appreciating the artistry of time tested techniques and skills and bringing them to the home seamstress.

feeds.title: The Renegade Seamstress
feeds.description: I'm a busy mom, wife, grandma and teacher who loves to create. I think refashioning and sewing is ridiculously fun. Through this blog, I hope to connect with those of you out there that love sewing as much as I do and possibly inspire a few of you to give it a try.

feeds.title: This Blog Is Not For You
feeds.description: Charlie shares her seamstress successes, and also her fashion fails, a lot of helpful tips and tricks, patterns and instructions along the way. Also covers tutorials to make your own handmade things.

feeds.title: Jennifer Lauren Vintage
feeds.description: Hello! I'm Jen and I design fun modern sewing patterns. I take the extra time to guide you through building your own beautiful wardrobe piece by piece by giving clear, concise instructions with all sewing levels in mind. Whether you're a beginner or an experienced seamstress, my patterns and tutorials will help you through the steps of building a handmade wardrobe that is fun, bright, and uniquely you.

feeds.title: Confessions of a Seamstress
feeds.description: I'm an experienced seamstress with a blog dedicated to providing resources for fellow costumers and fans. This blog is a peek into the world of a seamstress and how someone who creates clothing perceives fashion and costume choices in the media. Blog by Elizabeth Hajek.

feeds.title: The Avid Seamstress
feeds.description: Hello. We're The Avid Seamstress, a London based pattern company dedicated to helping modern women enjoy the art of sewing. The Avid Seamstress produces versatile & multi-functional sewing patterns to bring together a community of women that empower and inspire each other through sewing.

feeds.title: Sewisfaction Fabric and Sewing Studio Blog
feeds.description: Sewisfaction is an independent fabric and sewing studio focused on bringing you beautiful dressmaking fabrics, inspiring sewing patterns and unique haberdashery products. We're also spreading the joy of sewing at our dressmaking classes aimed at complete beginners through to more advanced sewists.

feeds.title: The Geeky Seamstress Blog
feeds.description: Hello and welcome to my corner of the web. I'm Mindy, and I've been cosplaying and sewing since early 2012. I created this site to keep track of all my crafty projects and provide advice for other crafters. You'll find lots of sewing and cosplaying tips, tricks, and breakdowns, as well as the occasional review of my favorite nerdy things.

feeds.title: poppykettle
feeds.description: An Industrial Engineer by day and a Sewing Enthusiast by night daydreaming of travelling the world in between. This space is for my love affair with all things garment construction. Making beautiful and well-made things to wear, enhancing my fabric stash at every given opportunity, many other sewing blogs for inspiration and appreciation are a few of my favourite things.

feeds.title: Sewing Like Mad
feeds.description: I am a formally trained seamstress. The goal with our education, besides being able to sew almost every type of garment, was to work closely with designers during their design process. When I moved to the US, all my sewing friends were back in Denmark and my new friends were not sewing so I started Sewing Like Mad as a way to connect with other sewing-interested folks and to share my knowledge.

feeds.title: The Itinerant Seamstress
feeds.description: I have four beautiful kids - two little girls and two littler boys. I began knitting while single, and dreamed of sewing my own clothes, but thought it was too hard. Then, while pregnant with my oldest daughter, I sewed a set of 12 cloth wipes. That was in 2009 and I haven't looked back.

feeds.title: The Young Sewphisticate
feeds.description: Needle and thread never far from hand, Anneliese is a seamstress, blogger and 19th-century living history interpreter at the Genesee Country Village & Museum. She pursues her passions for history and its clothing through costume construction and documents this journey. A sewing blog devoted to the past, present & future of costume.

feeds.title: Lazy Seamstress
feeds.description: Lazy Seamstress is a blog about sewing, and mumming and everything in between, and all around the edges.

feeds.title: Ten Thousand Hours of Sewing
feeds.description: I love to sew! It is like the air I breathe! I'm constantly trying to improve my skills. Experts have said it takes 10,000 hours of hard work to become an expert seamstress .

feeds.title: Clueless Seamstress
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Leigh. I'm a newbie seamstress in South Wales stumbling my way through teaching myself to sew. I blog here about my successes, failures and everything in between.

feeds.title: The Wardrobe Project
feeds.description: I'm Mady and I'm a self-taught seamstress and knitter. This is my journey towards a handmade wardrobe! I discovered the mind-blowing sewing blogosphere and I never stopped sewing since. Making things is my therapy and my goal is to one day have a wardrobe full of handmade clothes. I love learning new things and techniques, and sharing my passion with other lovely like-minded people out there.

feeds.title: Adventures of a Young Seamstress
feeds.description: I'm Shannon, a Montreal-based science student with a passion for sewing, knitting, and vintage fashion. I've been sewing since I was about six years old, but I only ever sewed I sporadically throughout my childhood and early teenage years, usually sewing clothes that I never ended up wearing.

feeds.title: Ravina the Seamstress
feeds.description: My aim of this blog is to not only show pieces of clothing I've made but also to show DIY tutorials, Friday Tips on sewing and I have a bunch of Christmas inspired decorations which I want to post.

feeds.title: Trish Stitched
feeds.description: Trish is a handbag designer, blogger, and the petite seamstress behind Trish Stitched. Trish makes and sells bags on Etsy, and makes clothing for her under 5′ frame. Trish went to school for Fashion, Costume Design and Business and now sews in her little Hoboken, NJ studio and works on her parents' farm. She loves color, floral prints, and buttons.

feeds.title: U&Mii
feeds.description: In the fashion world I am 'plus size'. Yes, siree, I've got curves and I'm not afraid to use 'em! I love that by sewing I can make unique clothes that I would never find in any shop, and make them so they actually fit me. What a revolutionary thought! After all, why shouldn't everyone rock their own personal style, regardless of size?

feeds.title: Urban Seamstress
feeds.description: Welcome to Urban Seamstress which is all about my adventures with fabric architecture. I think that I am possibly a frustrated architect deep down, but fortunately, I am sticking to using fabric so no one will be hurt in the making!
